tagline: Focused on Class A warehouse and distribution real estate investments in target markets in the Sunbelt and lower Midwest.
hero_kpi_rationale: The 27.7% effective rent growth on new leases reflects the company's ability to capture leasing market growth in its target markets and generate superior returns.

kpis.name: Occupancy Rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of leasable space currently rented.
kpis.description: The consolidated portfolio was 97.1% occupied as of December 31, 2025, with 1.5 million square feet of vacancy to be re-leased.
kpis.signal: Very high occupancy rate, indicating strong leasing demand

kpis.name: Lease Term
kpis.explanation: Weighted average remaining term of signed leases, in years.
kpis.description: Weighted average lease term: 4.8 years as of December 31, 2025.
kpis.signal: Lease stability with visibility into future revenues

kpis.name: Rent Escalation
kpis.explanation: Average contractual rent increases expected over lease terms.
kpis.description: 99.3% of leases include rent increases; average escalation rate: 2.8%.

kpis.name: Rent Growth New Leases
kpis.explanation: Increase in effective rent on new leases or renewals.
kpis.description: 27.7% effective rent growth on leases signed or renewed in 2025, excluding two fixed-rate renewals and two specific cases.
kpis.signal: Significant rent mark-to-market on new contracts

kpis.name: Acquisition Volume
kpis.explanation: Value of new assets acquired during the year.
kpis.description: Acquired one warehouse for $30 million in 2025, compared to $550.5 million in 2024.
kpis.signal: Drastic reduction in acquisitions in favor of deleveraging

kpis.name: Capital Recycling
kpis.explanation: Value of assets sold for reinvestment or debt reduction.
kpis.signal: Active deleveraging strategy through asset sales

kpis.name: Debt Repayment
kpis.explanation: Total amount of debt repaid during the year.
kpis.description: Repaid $50 million on a loan, repurchased $28.1 million in preferred shares and $140 million in notes, totaling $218.1 million.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total assets of €3.54 Bn in the latest year

kpis.name: Leasing Volume
kpis.explanation: Total square footage under new leases or renewals.
kpis.description: 4.9 million square feet of leases signed or renewed in 2025.
kpis.signal: Sustained leasing activity despite uncertain environment

kpis.name: Rent Growth New Leases
kpis.explanation: Increase in effective rent on new leases or renewals.
kpis.description: 27.7% effective rent growth on leases signed or renewed in 2025, excluding two fixed-rate renewals and two specific cases.
kpis.signal: Significant rent mark-to-market on new contracts

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company mentions increased competition for industrial property acquisitions, which could affect its ability to acquire new properties at competitive prices.

risks.title: Tenant Risks
risks.score_rationale: Uncertainty related to international trade policy is causing some tenants to reassess their space needs, which could impact rental revenues.

risks.title: Credit Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company monitors tenant creditworthiness, but there is a risk that tenants may fail to pay rent on time.

risks.title: Development Risks
risks.score_rationale: Development activities are subject to risks, including delays and cost overruns, which could affect results.

risks.title: Liquidity Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company has repaid debt and conducted share repurchases, but there is a liquidity risk if market conditions change.

ai_positioning.summary: LXP does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K/20-F filing.
